units.text: The 19th National Orchid Show opens on 23rd September 2027 in Stellenbosch.

retained.text: The National Show Symposium will feature an outstanding programme of presentations by respected local and international speakers covering orchid cultivation, breeding, conservation, taxonomy, judging, sustainability and emerging scientific research.

A Conference held by Wild Orchids Southern Africa (WOSA) will highlight the ecology and conservation of indigenous orchids, illustrating how research undertaken in natural habitats continues to influence cultivation practices, breeding programmes and the long-term future of orchids.
Workshops are planned as part of the wider event programme.
All South African Orchid Council members whose subscriptions are valid may enter orchids for judging. If you are unsure, please check with your society.

All submitted orchids will be placed in the Show display. Regional Societies may also have their own displays by booking a stand. They will also be able to sell society plants on behalf of their members.

retired.text: The National Orchid Show - Western Cape 2027 is the South African Orchid Council's premier triennial event, bringing together orchid enthusiasts, growers, researchers, conservationists, judges, horticultural professionals and members of the public to celebrate one of the world's most remarkable plant families.

The National Orchid Show will showcase a spectacular display of all the orchids that are submitted for judging and display. There will be specialist plant sales by local and international vendors, educational exhibits, a comprehensive symposium and conference, practical workshops and opportunities to engage with local and international experts.

Whether your passion lies in conservation, scientific discovery, judging, growing or simply enjoying the extraordinary beauty of orchids, the National Orchid Show – Western Cape 2027 offers an unforgettable experience that celebrates the complete journey of orchids and the people dedicated to their future.
